summary: The original fix corrects ArrayVec::insert, unlike the imported description of try_insert rejecting append positions. Previously, an index greater than len but below capacity reached the shifting code, causing len - index to underflow. The fix rejects these indices by returning Some(element) without modifying the vector, while preserving valid append positions below capacity. The test added by the fix inserts at index 1 into an empty vector of capacity 8. No tests were executed.
